_why: B-18.1, stop-the-line. CLAUDE.md went from 6,835 bytes to 0 and MERGED at
f8e515e with the whole suite green, because nothing in the repo asserted on
it. Both sessions then kept citing rules that no longer existed anywhere in
the tree. The governance layer failed silently.
THE HOLE THAT MADE A TEST INSUFFICIENT: ci.yml classifies a change whose
every path matches docs/*.md or *.md as docs-only and SKIPS npm test. Every
file listed here matches that pattern, so a PR that empties CLAUDE.md is
classified docs-only and never runs the suite guarding it. scripts/
check-governance.mjs therefore runs UNCONDITIONALLY in CI, with no npm
install and no node_modules, and the vitest suite reads this same manifest
so the two can never drift.
minBytes catches truncation. anchors catch partial resolution, which is the
likelier failure: a conflict resolved by taking one side can drop half the
doctrine while leaving a plausible-looking file behind.

anchors: docs/persona.md is the signed-off voice authority
This repo is public on purpose
